newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - New Dow components get a lift.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - New Dow components get a lift.

text.p: The four stocks to be added to the 30 Dow Jones Industrials firmed early Thursday, traders saying the inclusion raises cachet and creates demand from mutual funds and other institutional investors who "play the average."
After Wednesday's market close, Dow Jones & Co Inc announced Hewlett-Packard Co, Travelers Group Inc, Johnson & Johnson and Wal-Mart will replace four existing companies in the average.
Before the open, Johnson & Johnson added 3/4 to 60-3/8, Hewlett-Packard rose one to 55-5/8, Travelers was bid up 1/4 to 54-3/4 and Wal-Mart was bid 1/4 higher to 29.
The shares knocked out of the index were expected to open lower, traders said.

Westinghouse Electric Corp was offered 1/4 lower at 18-3/4, Texaco was also offered 1/4 lower at 102-1/2, Woolworth Corp was for sale 1/8 under last night's 22-7/8 close and Bethlehem Steel Corp was offered 1/4 lower at 8-1/2.
Elsewhere, Advanced Micro Devices extended yesterday's gains, rising as high as 47-1/2 in early third market activity, then easing back to 46-1/4.
Wednesday, the stock leaped over 10 percent, or 4-1/4 points, to 45-7/8.
The gains were attributed to positive analyst comments related to AMD's K6 microchip.
